notes.subject: ורהב
notes.rationale: 'go kgotlela / go hlohleletša' kgahlanong le KJV 'make sure thy friend' le YLT 'strengthen thy friend' — sephuthelwana sa bohlale se nyaka go nyenyefatša motho go kgala mogatla.

notes.subject: בכף
notes.rationale: 'lebatla' (sebaka sa seatla) — seswantšho sa go tsewa ka seatla, e sego 'letšatši' la seswantšho se sengwe.

notes.subject: morwa wa ka
notes.rationale: Puo e lebisa morwaneng yo a swerwego lebakeng la mogatla — taletso ya thušo.

notes.subject: Dira se… tšwaeta
notes.rationale: Ditaocomo tše tharo tša go gwetša go i phologa.

translation: Dira se, bjale, morwa wa ka, gomme i phologe, ka gobane o tsene lebatong la motšwari wa gago; tšwaeta, i khumame, gomme kgotlela motšwari wa gago.
